name: smwmusic-mega-man-x-eagle-has-landed-storm-eagle-s-stage-remix
title: Mega Man X - Eagle Has Landed ~ Storm Eagle's Stage (Remix)
description:
𝙏𝙝𝙚𝙣 𝙩𝙝𝙚 𝙡𝙚𝙖𝙨𝙩 𝙄 𝙘𝙖𝙣 𝙙𝙤 𝙞𝙨 𝙛𝙞𝙜𝙝𝙩 𝙬𝙞𝙩𝙝 𝙖𝙡𝙡 𝙢𝙮 𝙨𝙩𝙧𝙚𝙣𝙜𝙩𝙝.

Did a remix of Storm Eagle's Stage from Mega Man X1 / Xtreme. I think it was a given that I'd have to do this theme at some point given how many MMX1 arrangements I've done so far, and it's a classic for sure (even if it is short)!

Important:
♠ "Bonus End" is disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. B Minor (Original Pitch, turned on default)
2. C Minor (Maverick Hunter X Pitch)
3. C# Minor (Custom Pitch)
